listings.title: Free vegetarian lunch every weekday
listings.desc: A free food stall outside the SOAS entrance by Russell Square. Usually curry or pasta, always vegetarian. Open to everyone, no questions asked. You can volunteer to help serve.

listings.title: Bloomsbury Farmers' Market, Thursday lunch
listings.desc: Street food every Thursday between Birkbeck and SOAS: pies, curries, tacos, burritos, crêpes, pasta and cakes. Open rain or shine.

listings.title: Lunch market by Goodge Street
listings.desc: Food stalls beside Goodge Street station at lunchtime, from Italian to Korean. Prices similar to Bloomsbury market.

listings.title: £1.50 beans on toast breakfast
listings.desc: Weekday breakfast from 8 to 11am: beans or jam on toast £1.50, avocado on toast £2, breakfast pot £3.90. Jacket potatoes from £3 at lunch.

listings.title: £3.99 meal deal
listings.desc: Sandwich or wrap, a snack and a drink for £3.99. On Tuesdays, onigiri are half price (£1.40).

listings.title: £4.55 soup and roll
listings.desc: Soup of the day with a roll, or an Indian-inspired hot meal for £6.95.

listings.title: £3.70 lunch meal deal
listings.desc: KCLSU café in Bush House with a £3.70 lunch meal deal. A good place to study between lectures too.

listings.title: 75p porridge and £1.75 jacket potatoes
listings.desc: Budget range at King's Food outlets: porridge 75p, jacket potato with beans and salad £1.75. Food expiring that day is 50% off in the last 50 minutes before closing.

listings.title: Student-priced food and weekly curry nights
listings.desc: KCLSU bar and kitchen with daily food deals, curry nights, quizzes and karaoke. Halal, vegan and veggie options.

listings.title: Sandwiches and plates from £2.50
listings.desc: On-campus café next to the Old Building. Sandwiches and hot plates from £2.50 to £8.

listings.title: 10% off veggie thalis with a student card
listings.desc: London's veteran vegetarian restaurant since 1979. Generous portions, lots of vegan options. Show an NUS extra or ISIC card for 10% off.

listings.title: Leather Lane street food lunch
listings.desc: Weekday lunch market near Chancery Lane and the Maughan Library: jerk chicken, falafel, Korean, burritos. Arrive before 12:30 to beat the queue.

listings.title: Bhel poori lunch buffet
listings.desc: South Indian vegetarian institution on Drummond Street, London's original Little India, since 1971. The lunchtime buffet is a UCL favourite.

listings.title: All-you-can-eat veg buffet + drink, Mon–Thu
listings.desc: Unlimited vegetarian lunch buffet including a drink, Monday to Thursday until 2pm.

listings.title: £3–£4 surplus food bags near campus
listings.desc: Cafés, bakeries and shops sell unsold food as surprise bags, usually £3–£4 for at least double the value. Plenty of pickup spots around Bloomsbury, Holborn and the Strand.
listings.source: Too Good To Go · Food at LSE

listings.title: 24/7 study space with 641 seats
listings.desc: Open 24 hours, all year. 641 study spaces, 369 PCs, showers on B2, a café on level 3 and a roof terrace. UCL students and staff only.

listings.title: LSE Library (24/7 in term)
listings.desc: Open 24 hours in term for LSE students and staff. Hours change in the vacations, so check before a late-night visit.

listings.title: Maughan Library
listings.desc: King's main research library in a grand Victorian building. Tap in with your King's ID card. Check live hours before you go.

listings.title: Free library open to everyone 18+
listings.desc: Free to use with lots of desk space for quiet study and an area for group work. Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00, Sat 10:00–16:00, closed Sundays.

listings.title: Free Wi-Fi seats, or free Reader Pass
listings.desc: Anyone can work in the public areas with free Wi-Fi and plugs. Get a free Reader Pass (18+) to use the silent Reading Rooms, even if you don't need the collections.

listings.title: Senate House Library (free for UoL students)
listings.desc: The University of London's central library. Students at UoL colleges, including UCL and LSE, can join free and borrow. Check hours online.

listings.title: Welcome Fair: 200+ societies and sports clubs
listings.desc: Saturday 3 and Sunday 4 October, 10:00–17:00. Different stalls each day, freebies from local businesses, and live performances in the main quad. Free, but you must book a timed ticket with your UCL login.

listings.title: Welcome Fair meet-up: picnic in the park
listings.desc: Book a Welcome Fair meet-up ticket and you'll be invited to a picnic in the park on Thursday 1 October. A low-pressure way to meet people. Check the KCLSU site for the exact time and meeting point.

listings.title: UCL Banking, Finance & Economics Fair
listings.desc: Meet banks, funds and economics employers. Booking opens two weeks before. Bring a one-page CV.

listings.title: UCL Management Consultancy Fair
listings.desc: Consultancies recruiting interns and graduates from any degree. Booking opens two weeks before.

listings.title: UCL Tech, Data & AI Fair
listings.desc: Tech, data and AI employers hiring interns and grads. Booking opens two weeks before.

listings.title: UCL Engineering & Built Environment Fair
listings.desc: Engineering, construction and architecture employers. Booking opens two weeks before.

listings.title: The King's Careers Fair
listings.desc: Three days, different employers each day, 13–15 October. Aimed at penultimate and final years, but first-years go too to build contacts.

listings.title: Life & Health Science Careers Event
listings.desc: Joint fair for life and health science students at Imperial's South Kensington campus.

listings.title: Summer 2027 internships are opening now
listings.desc: Banks, Big 4 and tech firms open summer 2027 internships from September. Most review applications as they arrive, so applying early matters more than the deadline.

listings.title: Spring weeks 2027 for first-years
listings.desc: 3–5 day insight programmes run each spring. Applications open September to December 2026 and most are assessed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

listings.title: On-campus temp jobs at UCL
listings.desc: Casual roles around campus: student ambassador, bars, cafés, gym, labs and departments. Register once and get matched to shifts that fit your timetable.

listings.title: Local part-time jobs board
listings.desc: Part-time jobs from the Union and local employers who want UCL students.

listings.title: Flexible campus jobs at £15.29/hour
listings.desc: Temporary work across King's departments, the ambassador scheme, fundraising and KCLSU venues. Hours fit around your timetable.

listings.title: Part-time jobs on LSE CareerHub
listings.desc: Most on-campus roles are posted in CareerHub's part-time jobs section: research assistant, events, admin and more. LSE recommends no more than 15 hours a week in term.

listings.title: UCL Financial Assistance Fund
listings.desc: Non-repayable help with living costs if you hit unexpected money problems. Open an AskUCL enquiry with the Student Funding Office to apply. Check the page for 2026–27 opening dates.

listings.title: King's Hardship Funds
listings.desc: Help with rent, bills and travel for home and international students. Funds usually reopen in mid-October each year.

listings.title: Claim your council tax exemption
listings.desc: Full-time students don't pay council tax, but you usually have to claim. Download a student certificate from your uni and send it to your borough council.

listings.title: 30% off Travelcards with an 18+ Student Oyster
listings.desc: Get 30% off weekly and monthly Travelcards and bus passes. Apply online with a photo, your student ID and a £20 fee; your uni verifies you. Not valid on pay-as-you-go fares.

listings.title: 1/3 off train fares with a 16–25 Railcard
listings.desc: Pays for itself in one or two trips home. Full-time students aged 26+ qualify too, using the mature student form.

listings.title: £10 National Theatre tickets for 19–25s
listings.desc: £10 tickets (£5 if you're 16–18) on selected shows, up to two per production. Book online and bring photo ID.

listings.title: £5 exhibition tickets with Tate Collective
listings.desc: Free to join if you're 16–25. See any Tate exhibition for £5 and bring up to three friends at £5 each.

listings.title: £5–£15 tickets with Young Barbican
listings.desc: Free membership with cheap tickets across art, film, music, theatre and dance, plus 10% off food and drink. Bring a friend at the same price.

listings.title: British Museum: free, five minutes from campus
listings.desc: Free entry to the permanent collection. Some special exhibitions charge.

listings.title: Student gym: £229 for the whole year
listings.desc: Annual student membership with full gym and class access for £229 if you join between 1 September and 31 October. Price frozen from last year.

listings.title: LSESU Gym from £5 a day
listings.org: LSESU Gym, Saw Swee Hock Centre
listings.desc: Students' Union gym on campus. Day passes and monthly memberships, see the site for all options.

listings.title: King's Sport & Wellness student gym
listings.desc: Discounted student memberships at the Strand gym and other campuses. Pay-monthly has a £10 joining fee.

listings.title: Intercollegiate Halls in Bloomsbury
listings.desc: Central halls shared by University of London colleges, including UCL, King's and LSE. 40-week contracts from mid-September; some rooms become available mid-year.

listings.title: UCL halls and private housing advice
listings.desc: UCL's halls options, plus guidance on renting privately in London safely.
